biggest_catch: To earn the $100 savings bonus you must park $5,000 in the new savings account for 30 days after opening — no spending, but the money is tied up — and if the balance ever falls below $100 there is a $5.00 monthly service fee.
catches: To qualify for the one-time $100 savings bonus, the new savings account must have a balance of $5,000 or more 30 days from the date the account was opened — the $5,000 is your own refundable deposit, not a fee, but it must sit in the account.
Bonus is for new members only — defined as those who have not been a member of AdelFi Credit Union in the last 24 months.
Use Promo Code 'Bee' when applying; bonus offer ends 12/31/26.
Must register and use Online/Mobile Banking; membership eligibility required.
$100 minimum to open. There is a $5.00 monthly service fee if the balance falls below $100.00 (no fee for Custodian Accounts under age 18).
One Harvest Savings account per member.
Special bonus offers will be deposited after 30 days for Harvest Savings once approval of membership eligibility and bonus eligibility requirements have been met.
Bonus is considered taxable income and the recipient may be responsible for any tax implications.
The advertised 5.00% APY applies to balances up to $5,000 and is tiered/variable after account opening.

steps: On the AdelFi bonus page, start an application for a Harvest High-Yield Savings account using promo code 'Bee' (bonus offer ends 12/31/26).
Complete AdelFi membership (membership eligibility required) and fund the new savings account with at least $5,000 ($100 minimum to open).
Register for and use Online/Mobile Banking.
Maintain a balance of $5,000 or more for 30 days from the date the account was opened; after approval of membership and bonus eligibility, the $100 bonus is deposited after 30 days.
